correctness.rationale: The projective plane has exactly 13 points, 52 forbidden collinear triples, and f-vector (13,78,234,234). The full 1-skeleton and off-line cone of every missing triangle give rank_Q boundary2=66. Exact boundary3 column reduction modulo primes 101 and 1009 gives rank168; chain-complex identity gives upper bound 234-66=168, so H3_Q=66 and all other reduced rational homology vanishes. The enclosed verifier constructs all 5616 distinct PGL3(F3) transformations; signed simplicial Lefschetz traces equal the exterior-square augmentation character for EACH element, and zero group-average trace gives zero invariants. Code and actual VERIFY_OK output are embedded. The rank computation is a finite certificate for the specified finite domain, not an infinite inference.

value.rationale: The natural 13-point projective-plane cap/oval complex carries a large canonical automorphism group. Determining that its 66-dimensional top homology is the exterior square of the reduced point permutation module gives the complete symmetry action, exact eight-class character and the vanishing of invariant rational cycles, none inferable from the previously known Betti number 66 or top-face transitivity alone. This structural equivariant identification is useful for comparison with other finite planes and equivariant complexes; it does not assert a larger general theorem.
